papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.desc: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict.

papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
papers.desc: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model.

papers.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
papers.desc: Video generation models are promising foundations for embodied world models, but only if their generated rollouts are physically valid and faithful to task instructions.

papers.title: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.desc: KANLab is a browser-based visualization tool designed to interactively teach the core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), forked from the widely successful TensorFlow Playground.

papers.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
papers.desc: Repeated event forecasting requires extracting predictive signals from noisy evidence and evaluating their value across successive decisions.

papers.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
papers.desc: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions.

papers.title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
papers.desc: We examine how closely pretrained LeWorldModel (LeWM) reproduces the effects of small action changes.

papers.title: Judging the Justification: Decision Certificate Supervision for Generative Reward Models
papers.desc: Generative reward models (GenRMs) generate natural language rationales to justify preference judgments, yet a correct verdict does not guarantee a sound justification.

papers.title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
papers.desc: Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates give state-space guarantees of stability and safety, but synthesizing and verifying them---especially for nonlinear, high-dimensional systems---remains an open challenge.

papers.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation.

papers.title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
papers.desc: Slider-based control aims to give users continuous, fine-grained control over the intensity of individual edits in instruction-based image editing.

papers.title: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
papers.desc: In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation.

papers.title: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
papers.desc: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts.

papers.title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
papers.desc: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels.

papers.title: What Git Does Not Record: Provenance Legibility in Two AI-Assisted Research Repositories
papers.desc: Publishers and funders increasingly ask authors to disclose how AI tools contributed to a piece of research.
